doc.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Orchestrating the Broadway show Sugar Babies
summary: Sugar Babies is the only Broadway show he orchestrated; it now runs in cut-down versions.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh yeah. You just did “Sugar Babies” not that long ago.
Well it’s been a while back.

“Sugar Babies” was the only Broadway show I’ve orchestrated. It ran for quite a few years and they tell me it’s still running now in dinner theaters and bus and truck stops and that kind of thing. By now, whatever I orchestrated is long gone. It’s been cut down to a combo.
